page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by custom AWS arm64 Graviton architecture running on the Nitro hypervisor. The instance provides 8 dedicated physical cores operating at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz, with one hardware thread per core to eliminate resource contention common to simultaneous multithreading. It features 16.0 GB of system memory, matching a compute-oriented allocation profile of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

In addition to compute resources, the platform incorporates 474 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD instance storage. This local storage delivers low latency and high I/O throughput directly to the host, though it functions as ephemeral storage tied to the instance lifecycle. Network connectivity is provisioned at a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. The instance contains zero GPUs, focusing hardware capability entirely on general-purpose compute and direct-attached storage performance.

From an efficiency standpoint, the dedicated 64-bit ARM core design delivers consistent execution throughput and strong computing density relative to hardware resource consumption. The inclusion of bundled local NVMe storage reduces reliance on external network volumes for high-frequency temporary disk operations. Consequently, the configuration fits compute-intensive workloads that require fast local scratch space, such as continuous integration build agents, software compilation, batch processing, and distributed analytics tasks.
